headline: So apparently, I have a type.
subhead: Different medium, same obsessions: people, why they do what they do, what they make, and what makes something worth coming back to.

themes.name: Understanding
themes.from: Rom-coms, ensemble shows, psychology books, emotionally specific lyrics
themes.why: I’m endlessly interested in why people choose each other, misunderstand each other, and change.

themes.name: Making
themes.from: Product books, creativity talks, whole discographies
themes.why: I like seeing how something goes from an idea to a thing people care about.

themes.name: Feeling
themes.from: Nostalgic songs, comfort shows, happy endings, books I reread
themes.why: I don’t come back to things just because they’re “good.” I come back to things that make me feel something.
